name: Asura-Tainted Gargoyle
journal_prompt: A devolved offshoot of humanity whose skin has calcified into a stone-like hide, animating only at night to hunt.
placement_note: Held with the sky set rather than the Asura set. It lives on the undersides of the floating islands, so it has no ground biome; it is reserved for a future sky mode. Empty `biomes` here is a decision.
